title: Certificate for A Metric with Positive Sectional Curvature on S3 x S3

claims.statement: The finite exact curvature identities identified in CLAIM-MAP.md agree with the displayed rational formulas in the paper.
claims.logical_role: These identities are inputs to the paper's geometric argument from the twice-Cheeger background to strict positive sectional curvature.

claims.statement: The generic cubic, smooth diagonal path, and type-II Schur coefficient pass the additional exact audits listed in CLAIM-MAP.md.
claims.logical_role: These checks target the moving-plane and exceptional-stratum calculations most vulnerable to sign, normalization, and complement errors.

claims.statement: Selected coefficients agree with a separately differentiated sphere-coordinate implementation within the stated tolerances.
claims.logical_role: Corroborative floating-point evidence only; not a proof certificate.
